case_title: Bhadresh Bipinbhai Sheth v. State of Gujarat & Another
neutral_facts: The accused and the victim were neighbours. The victim alleged that the accused harassed her over a period of time, including allegations of rape, emotional blackmail, and threats. The victim initially filed a complaint with the police in 2001, but the charge was initially framed under Section 506(2) of the IPC. The victim did not take any steps for almost 9 years, and the charge under Section 376 IPC was added in 2014. The investigation was complete, and the accused participated in the proceedings. The trial court granted anticipatory bail, which was later cancelled by the High Court. The Supreme Court set aside the High Court's order and restored the trial court's decision to grant anticipatory bail.
